lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo a(n)tar so baahar dekhahu avar na doojaa koee jeeu ||
lines.translation: He is within - see Him outside as well; there is no one, other than Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh ek drisat kar dekhahu ghat ghat jot samoee jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, look upon all with the single eye of equality; in each and every heart, the Divine Light is contained. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲਤੌ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chalatau thaak rakhahu ghar apanai gur miliai ih mat hoee jeeu ||
lines.translation: Restrain your fickle mind, and keep it steady within its own home; meeting the Guru, this understanding is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਰਹਉ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dekh adrisat rahau bisamaadee dukh bisarai sukh hoee jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: Seeing the unseen Lord, you shall be amazed and delighted; forgetting your pain, you shall be at peace. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੀਵਹੁ ਅਪਿਉ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: peevahu apiu param sukh paaeeai nij ghar vaasaa hoee jeeu ||
lines.translation: Drinking in the ambrosial nectar, you shall attain the highest bliss, and dwell within the home of your own self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran bhav bha(n)jan gaaeeai punarap janam na hoee jeeu ||4||
lines.translation: So sing the Praises of the Lord, the Destroyer of the fear of birth and death, and you shall not be reincarnated again. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਸੋਹੰ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tat nira(n)jan jot sabaaee soha(n) bhed na koee jeeu ||
lines.translation: The essence, the immaculate Lord, the Light of all - I am He and He is me - there is no difference between us.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: apara(n)par paarabraham paramesar naanak gur miliaa soee jeeu ||5||11||
lines.translation: The Infinite Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God - Nanak has met with Him, the Guru. ||5||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ghar 3 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehl, Third House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bhaavaa tad hee gaavaa ||
lines.translation: When I am pleasing to Him, then I sing His Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਗਾਵੇ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa gaave kaa phal paavaa ||
lines.translation: Singing His Praises, I receive the fruits of my rewards.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੇ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaave kaa phal hoee ||
lines.translation: The rewards of singing His Praises

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaa aape devai soee ||1||
lines.translation: Are obtained when He Himself gives them. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere gur bachanee nidh paaee ||
lines.translation: O my mind, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the treasure is obtained;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa te sach mahi rahiaa samaaee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: this is why I remain immersed in the True Name. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur saakhee a(n)tar jaagee ||
lines.translation: When I awoke within myself to the Guru's Teachings,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਚੰਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa cha(n)chal mat tiaagee ||
lines.translation: then I renounced my fickle intellect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਕਾ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur saakhee kaa ujeeaaraa ||
lines.translation: When the Light of the Guru's Teachings dawned,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਧੵਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: taa mitiaa sagal a(n)dhyaaraa ||2||
lines.translation: and then all darkness was dispelled. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur charanee man laagaa ||
lines.translation: When the mind is attached to the Guru's Feet,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa jam kaa maarag bhaagaa ||
lines.translation: then the Path of Death recedes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai vich nirabhau paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Through the Fear of God, one attains the Fearless Lord;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਸਹਜੈ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: taa sahajai kai ghar aaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: then, one enters the home of celestial bliss. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak boojhai ko beechaaree ||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, how rare are those who reflect and understand,

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: is jag mahi karanee saaree ||
lines.translation: the most sublime action in this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: karanee keerat hoee ||
lines.translation: The noblest deed is to sing the Lord's Praises,

lines.transliteration: jaa aape miliaa soee ||4||1||12||
lines.translation: and so meet the Lord Himself. ||4||1||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevak sev karahi sabh teree jin sabadai saad aaiaa ||
lines.translation: All of Your servants, who relish the Word of Your Shabad, serve You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa te niramal hoaa jin vichahu aap gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, they become pure, eradicating self-conceit from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anadin gun gaavahi nit saache gur kai sabad suhaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Night and day, they continually sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; they are adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere thaakur ham baarik saran tumaaree ||
lines.translation: O my Lord and Master, I am Your child; I seek Your Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਕੇਵਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko sachaa sach too keval aap muraaree || rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are the One and Only Lord, the Truest of the True; You Yourself are the Destroyer of ego. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaagat rahe tinee prabh paaiaa sabade haumai maaree ||
lines.translation: Those who remain wakeful obtain God; through the Word of the Shabad, they conquer their ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਰਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: girahee mahi sadaa har jan udaasee giaan tat beechaaree ||
lines.translation: Immersed in family life, the Lord's humble servant ever remains detached; he reflects upon the essence of spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh paaiaa har raakhiaa ur dhaaree ||2||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, he finds eternal peace, and he keeps the Lord enshrined in his heart. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu manooaa dah dis dhaavadaa doojai bhaai khuaaiaa ||
lines.translation: This mind wanders in the ten directions; it is consumed by the love of duality.
